tools.name: servicenow_batch
tools.title: Run a ServiceNow batch
tools.description: Run several REST sub-requests in one round-trip (Batch API). Each sub-request runs through the same read-only and table-access policy as a direct call.

id.description: Id echoed in the matching result.

url.description: API path under the instance origin, e.g. '/api/now/table/incident?sysparm_limit=1'.

headers.description: Extra headers (Accept and Content-Type are automatic).

apply.description: true executes; omitted: a non-mutating plan preview (SN_WRITE_MODE=apply executes by default).

tools.name: servicenow_check_capabilities
tools.title: Check achievable capabilities
tools.description: Preflight which sys_* tables are readable and which capabilities work — run it before scripts/flows/codecheck on a governed instance. 'groups' picks matrix probes; results are cached (refresh:true).

groups.description: Groups to probe (default all), one read-only probe each; update_sets adds canRead / canSet (inferred). The sys_* preflight always runs.

refresh.description: Discard the cache and probe again.

tools.name: servicenow_check_code_health
tools.title: Code health report
tools.description: Code-health report: script counts, ACL scan, table lint, new/fixed findings vs baseline. Writes <profile>/code-health.md.

scope.description: Table to lint; omit for an instance-wide inventory.

extended.description: Also count opt-in types and lint every script type instance-wide (newest `limit`).

limit.description: Records per type for extended, candidates per rule for domains (default 50).

domains.description: Also run the flow, portal, UI Builder and legacy-workflow analysers.

update_baseline.description: Reset the baseline to this run; otherwise new/fixed findings are reported against it.

scan_run.description: Run Instance Scan; point: scope+sys_id, suite: sys_id.

tools.name: servicenow_compare_instances
tools.title: Compare two instances
tools.description: Diff two profiles: tables, column differences, scripts missing/renamed/changed (unified diff), plugin/app inventory, optional record sections. Writes _compare/<a>-vs-<b>.md.

from_snapshot.description: Prefer stored snapshot JSON over live reads (default false).

sections.description: Snapshot record sections to compare too, matched by sys_id then name (default none).

types.description: Registry types (with children) or ['all']; default none.

mermaid.description: With types: diff changed flow/workflow/portal/experience diagrams as Mermaid (live).

raw.description: With types: add the JSON diff behind each UIB element diff.

format.description: 'json' (default) or 'file': write the full (redacted) JSON to <profile>/exports/, return { path, bytes, preview } + summary.

tools.name: servicenow_compare_update_set
tools.title: Compare update set
tools.description: Compare an update set's artefacts with another profile (live) or a stored snapshot: a status per artefact (same, different with field names, missing, …) plus a summary. Audit columns ignored.

update_set.description: Update set sys_id or exact name (a shared name resolves to the one in progress).

with_profile.description: Profile to compare against live; this or with_snapshot.

with_snapshot.description: Profile snapshot to compare with (record sections); this or with_profile.

tools.name: servicenow_create_record
tools.title: Create ServiceNow record
tools.description: Create a new record in a table with the given field values.

inputDisplayValue.description: Values are display values the instance resolves (sysparm_input_display_value); default false: raw.

update_set.description: Update set (sys_id or exact name, in progress) to record the write in; switched for it, then restored. Default SN_UPDATE_SET, else unchanged. Data-row tables are not captured.

apply.description: true executes; omitted: a non-mutating plan preview (SN_WRITE_MODE=apply executes by default).

tools.name: servicenow_delete_record
tools.title: Delete ServiceNow record
tools.description: Delete a record from a table by its sys_id.

update_set.description: Update set (sys_id or exact name, in progress) to record the write in; switched for it, then restored. Default SN_UPDATE_SET, else unchanged. Data-row tables are not captured.

expected_mod_count.description: sys_mod_count from the plan's apply_with; with apply, a changed record is refused (STALE_RECORD).

apply.description: true executes; omitted: a non-mutating plan preview (SN_WRITE_MODE=apply executes by default).

tools.name: servicenow_describe_table
tools.title: Describe ServiceNow table
tools.description: List a table's columns from sys_dictionary (name, label, type, mandatory, reference, default, flags). details:true adds choice lists and dictionary overrides.

details.description: Add choice lists and dictionary overrides (two extra reads).

tools.name: servicenow_describe_table_logic
tools.title: Explain ServiceNow table logic
tools.description: The automation on a table: business rules (by when+order), client scripts, UI policies, UI actions, ACLs. Metadata only.

tools.name: servicenow_document_app
tools.title: Document an application
tools.description: Write <profile>/apps/<scope>.md + .json for one scoped app: record, tables with an ER diagram, roles, cross-scope privileges, artefacts by type group, caveats. Not for 'global'. write:false returns the Markdown instead.

profile.description: Profile: 'current' (default) or a name; writes to its docs folder.

write.description: false returns the Markdown, writing nothing.

detail.description: Add a Mermaid diagram per flow/subflow/workflow/portal/UIB experience, a dependency graph and a lint summary (bounded).

kind.description: i18n: write i18n/<scope>.md, missing translations instead.

language.description: i18n: one language code; default all active.

tools.name: servicenow_document_instance
tools.title: Document the instance
tools.description: Write <profile>/README.md (version, counts, apps, plugins, automation, update sets) and artifact-types.md, plus one document per named table, app and kind (security, catalog, integrations); depth adds discovery/. A cancel keeps finished files.

profile.description: Profile: 'current' (default) or a name; writes to its docs folder.

kinds.description: Instance-wide documents to add, each as <kind>.md.

depth.description: Discovery tier under discovery/: overview, apps (+ per-scope tables), artefacts (+ per-scope artefacts); for 'apps', else every scope.

write.description: false returns the Markdown, writing nothing.

format.description: 'json' (default) or 'file': write the result JSON to <SN_DOCS_DIR>/<profile>/exports/ and return { path, bytes, preview }.

tools.name: servicenow_document_table
tools.title: Document a table
tools.description: Write <profile>/tables/<table>.md + .json from metadata: inheritance, columns, references, ER and flow diagrams, rules, client scripts, UI policies/actions, ACLs, caveats. A Purpose manual block survives re-runs.

profile.description: Profile: 'current' (default) or a name; writes to its docs folder.

write.description: false returns the Markdown, writing nothing.

tools.name: servicenow_explain_artifact
tools.title: Explain artifact
tools.description: Explain one artifact of any registry type: summary, trigger fields, non-empty fields, children, referenced records, decoded JSON fields and type-specific readings (state models, policy effects).

artifactType.description: Registry type id, e.g. 'business_rule'; all types: servicenow://artifact-types.

key.description: Natural key (keyFields): a value for a single key field, else an object of every key field; this or 'sys_id'.

tools.name: servicenow_explain_ui_experience
tools.title: Explain a UI Builder experience
tools.description: Explain a UI Builder experience/workspace (path or sys_id) as a page map: routes → screens → macroponents → data brokers and ACLs; plus landing, dashboards, lists, form actions. Metadata only.

format.description: json (default), markdown (report + diagram), mermaid (page map) or file (JSON to exports/).

detail.description: Depth: element props/components, bindings, event chains, script bodies. file default: all.

tools.name: servicenow_generate_er_diagram
tools.title: Generate ER diagram
tools.description: Mermaid erDiagram from sys_dictionary: an entity per table, a relationship per reference field. columns / max_columns / depth give a detailed view: PK/FK and required markers, extends edges, referenced tables.

columns.description: all: whole chain; own: the table's own; keys: sys_id, references, mandatory.

depth.description: Reference levels to follow, adding targets (0).

format.description: 'inline' (default) or 'file': write <profile>/diagrams/<name>.mmd, return { path, bytes, preview }.

tools.name: servicenow_get_artifact
tools.title: Get artifact
tools.description: Read one artifact of any registry type in full: the record, its registry children (e.g. UI policy actions, page layout), scope and SDK-managed verdict. By sys_id or natural key; denied child tables show as redacted.

artifactType.description: Registry type id, e.g. 'business_rule'; all types: servicenow://artifact-types.

key.description: Natural key (keyFields): a value for a single key field, else an object of every key field; this or 'sys_id'.

tools.name: servicenow_get_artifact_dependencies
tools.title: Artifact dependencies
tools.description: Dependency graph of one artifact: outbound (references, decoded JSON, script calls, GlideRecord tables, UIB components and brokers) and inbound (reverse references, script, flow-step and UIB page callers). Depth-capped; JSON or Mermaid.

artifactType.description: Registry type id, e.g. 'business_rule'; all types: servicenow://artifact-types.

key.description: Natural key (keyFields): a value for a single key field, else an object of every key field; this or 'sys_id'.

depth.description: Levels to walk (default 1); cycles visited once.

format.description: json (default) nodes and edges, or mermaid.

tools.name: servicenow_get_flow_runs
tools.title: Get flow run history
tools.description: Flow runs from sys_flow_context, by flow sys_id or by the record it ran against: start, state and outcome.

tools.name: servicenow_get_record
tools.title: Get ServiceNow record
tools.description: Read a single record from a table by its sys_id.

tools.name: servicenow_get_record_history
tools.title: Get record history
tools.description: Read a record's history: sys_audit changes and journal entries (comments, work_notes), newest first — journal fields read back empty via the Table API. Each source degrades separately.

source.description: all (default), audit (field changes) or journal (comments / work notes).

fields.description: Only these fields / journal elements, e.g. ['state','work_notes'].

since.description: Only entries at or after 'YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM:SS]'.

tools.name: servicenow_get_script
tools.title: Get ServiceNow script
tools.description: Read one script artefact in full: source code and execution context.

type.description: Script type; opt-in (read only when named): graphql_resolver, graphql_type_resolver, uib_client_script, uib_client_script_include, uib_data_broker_transform, uib_data_broker_scriptlet, sp_ng_template, sp_angular_provider, sp_theme, sp_css, sp_search_source.

tools.name: servicenow_get_status
tools.title: Get ServiceNow connection status
tools.description: Show instance, auth, missing credentials, per-profile write mode, policy, limits, TLS, queue, write counters, version, uptime. Secrets are never shown.

tools.name: servicenow_get_update_set
tools.title: Get update set
tools.description: Summarise one update set: its customer updates (sys_update_xml) per artefact — type, target, action, table — with counts; UIB pages it touches list the records it lacks. include_payload adds parsed field values, capped, secrets masked.

update_set.description: Update set sys_id or exact name (a shared name resolves to the one in progress).

type.description: Only this type label, e.g. 'Business Rule'.

tools.name: servicenow_lint_script
tools.title: Lint a script
tools.description: Run deterministic code-quality rules on one script (hard-coded sys_ids, unbounded or in-loop GlideRecord, eval, …): findings with rule, severity, line, fix hint.

tools.name: servicenow_list_instances
tools.title: List connection profiles
tools.description: List the connection profiles: name, host, user, auth method (and OAuth grant), refresh-token state, read-only flag, write mode, credentials complete. Secrets are never included.

tools.name: servicenow_list_update_sets
tools.title: List update sets
tools.description: List update sets, newest first, with state, scope and whether each is the user's current one. Filter by state, name or application.

query.description: Extra encoded query ANDed with the filters.

tools.name: servicenow_list_writes
tools.title: List journaled writes
tools.description: List the local write journal (newest first): every write this server made, with entry id, outcome and whether servicenow_revert_write can invert it. Filter by profile, table, since, result or action.

profile.description: Profile whose journal to read (default: active).

since.description: Only writes at or after this ISO 8601 time.

verbose.description: Full journal lines (fields, before) instead of summaries.

tools.name: servicenow_query_table
tools.title: Query ServiceNow table
tools.description: Read records from any table (Table API): encoded query, fields, paging, fetchAll. '^' cannot be escaped inside a value; very long queries can hit HTTP 414 — split them. See the servicenow://reference/encoded-query resource.

displayValue.description: 'true' display, 'false' raw (default), 'all' both, 'display' compact ([sys_id, name] refs).

omitEmpty.description: Drop empty cells; columns are listed.

fetchAll.description: All matches (≤ SN_MAX_RECORDS): sys_id cursor without an ORDERBY (stable), else offset.

noCount.description: Skip the row count (sysparm_no_count): faster on huge tables; 'total' unknown.

format.description: 'json' (default), 'csv', 'table' (columns + rows) or 'file': the full (redacted) result to <profile>/exports/.

fileFormat.description: With format 'file': 'csv' (default; columns from 'fields' or page 1) or 'jsonl' (all keys).

explain.description: Read no records: which conditions can use an index, with cost notes (advice).

tools.name: servicenow_read_doc
tools.title: Read instance doc
tools.description: Read one local Markdown doc or its .json companion; the result carries its mimeType.

path.description: Path relative to the docs (or 'profile') folder, e.g. 'tables/incident.md'.

profile.description: Profile folder: 'current' or a name; omit for all.

tools.name: servicenow_read_ops
tools.title: Read instance operations data
tools.description: Bounded ops views for 'why is it slow' triage: overview, syslog, jobs (sys_trigger), email_queue, semaphores, integrations (failed/slow outbound), transactions (slow), mid (MID/ECC queue). Unreadable section: available:false + why.

filter.description: jobs: 'overdue' (default; ready, past next action), 'running' or 'queued'.

overdue_minutes.description: jobs: minutes past next_action before a ready job counts as overdue (default 5, max 1440).

tools.name: servicenow_revert_write
tools.title: Revert a journaled write
tools.description: Undo one applied write from the local journal: an update restores its before values, a create is deleted, a delete is re-created. Refused if the record changed since (unless force:true) or the line is not invertible (NOT_REVERTIBLE). Journaled.

force.description: Revert even if the record changed since (or that cannot be verified), overwriting the later changes.

apply.description: true executes; omitted: a non-mutating plan preview (SN_WRITE_MODE=apply executes by default).

tools.name: servicenow_search_code
tools.title: Search ServiceNow code
tools.description: Search script source for a literal substring across one or all script types. One entry per artefact: a snippet plus matching lines with one line of context (max 20; hitCount is the total), not whole scripts. Answers 'where is X used?'.

type.description: One type; opt-in (read only when named): graphql_resolver, graphql_type_resolver, uib_client_script, uib_client_script_include, uib_data_broker_transform, uib_data_broker_scriptlet, sp_ng_template, sp_angular_provider, sp_theme, sp_css, sp_search_source.

table.description: Only scripts applied to this table.

extended.description: Without 'type': also search the opt-in types after the default ones (default false).

tools.name: servicenow_search_docs
tools.title: Search instance docs
tools.description: Search the local docs for a substring: a snippet and nearest heading per match (max SN_DOCS_SEARCH_MAX, then 'truncated').

profile.description: Profile folder: 'current' or a name; omit for all.

kind.description: Only generated documents of this kind, e.g. 'tables'.

generated.description: true: only generated; false: only hand-written.

tools.name: servicenow_set_credentials
tools.title: Set ServiceNow credentials
tools.description: Save connection credentials to the env file for later requests (any subset; auth / oauth_client_id / oauth_grant pick the method). Secrets are never arguments: list them in request_secrets for elicitation. See 'instance' for host changes.

instance.description: Instance host, e.g. 'dev12345'. A change needs the new host's auth in the same call (Basic: user + password, else CREDENTIALS_INCOMPLETE) and elicitation confirmation unless SN_ALLOW_UNCONFIRMED_CREDENTIAL_CHANGE=1.

request_secrets.description: Secrets to enter through elicitation (never as arguments).

profile.description: Profile (default active); a new name creates one.

tools.name: servicenow_snapshot_instance
tools.title: Snapshot instance metadata
tools.description: Download structural metadata to SN_DOCS_DIR/<profile>/ as Markdown + JSON: tables, schemas, plugins, apps, script stats, properties (secrets redacted), choices, ACLs, flows, catalog, roles. resume:true resumes.

resume.description: Skip sections whose files carry the recorded source hash.

types.description: Registry types (with children) or ['all']; default none.

format.description: 'json' (default) or 'file': write the full (redacted) JSON to <profile>/exports/, return { path, bytes, preview } + summary.

tools.name: servicenow_test_connection
tools.title: Test ServiceNow connection
tools.description: Verify the credentials work: reads one sys_user record, reports ok/status/latency. Auth and connectivity problems come back as ok:false, not errors.

tools.name: servicenow_trace_table_event
tools.title: Trace a table event
tools.description: Trace what would run for a table operation, in order, without executing: business rules by phase (inherited and global too), flows, workflows, notifications, with conditions and a Mermaid flowchart. 'lanes' adds more.

lanes.description: Lanes beyond business rules, flows, workflows, notifications: transform_map, scheduled_job (text match), client (client scripts + UI policies), data_policy, sla, event_script.

tools.name: servicenow_update_record
tools.title: Update ServiceNow record
tools.description: Update fields on an existing record identified by its sys_id.

inputDisplayValue.description: Values are display values the instance resolves (sysparm_input_display_value); default false: raw.

update_set.description: Update set (sys_id or exact name, in progress) to record the write in; switched for it, then restored. Default SN_UPDATE_SET, else unchanged. Data-row tables are not captured.

expected_mod_count.description: sys_mod_count from the plan's apply_with; with apply, a changed record is refused (STALE_RECORD).

apply.description: true executes; omitted: a non-mutating plan preview (SN_WRITE_MODE=apply executes by default).

tools.name: servicenow_upsert_record
tools.title: Upsert ServiceNow record
tools.description: Create or update one record matched by an exact key of field/value pairs: no match creates, one updates, several are refused (AMBIGUOUS_KEY). Pass the plan's expected_action / expected_sys_id with apply:true; a changed decision gives STALE_RECORD.

key.description: Field/value pairs identifying the record, matched on raw values ('' matches an empty field); no '^' in values.

values.description: Fields to write (plus the key fields on create).

expected_action.description: The plan's action; with apply, refused (STALE_RECORD) if the key now resolves differently.

expected_sys_id.description: The plan's sys_id; with apply, refused (STALE_RECORD) if the key now matches another record or none.

inputDisplayValue.description: Values are display values the instance resolves (sysparm_input_display_value); default false: raw.

update_set.description: Update set (sys_id or exact name, in progress) to record the write in; switched for it, then restored. Default SN_UPDATE_SET, else unchanged. Data-row tables are not captured.

apply.description: true executes; omitted: a non-mutating plan preview (SN_WRITE_MODE=apply executes by default).

tools.name: servicenow_use_instance
tools.title: Switch connection profile
tools.description: Switch the connection profile (over HTTP: this session only unless persist).

persist.description: Write the env file (journaled). Default: stdio yes, HTTP no.

tools.name: servicenow_where_used
tools.title: Where used
tools.description: Find references to a table, field (table.field) or script: matching script lines, rules/ACLs on a table, structural config (reference fields, layouts, variables, flow inputs, reports). Optional scope and Mermaid graph.

kind.description: A table, a field, or a script/script-include name (also a UIB component, macroponent or broker sys_id).

name.description: Name to find usages of (table, table.field or script).

mermaid.description: Also render a Mermaid reference graph.

extended.description: Also search the opt-in UIB / portal script types.
